verdicts.reason: A drops the attribution and floats a sun-mark logo in the middle whose SOLSTICE wordmark is too small to read; the small can-and-circle sits off on its own, so the right half is mostly dead space and the layout looks scattered. B fills the banner from left to right (quote, can, attribution) with better balance, but it drops the logo, and the attribution in bold yellow caps is set nearly as large as the quote, so the two compete for attention.
